title: Industrial Sales Representative

Job descriptionTurner Hydraulics Inc. is seeking a salesperson for the central PA area to promote and sell Hydraulic Repair, Parts, and Services. Visit our facility to learn about the variety of services and products that can make your career successful.JOB DESCRIPTIONWe are seeking a motivated individual to join our company as an outside salesperson, calling on mobile and industrial facilities for component repair services.
